if you have to go here for an emergency make sure someone comes with you otherwise you won't get any attention or care if you need it. i went to the emergency room via ambulance due to severe vomiting diarrhea and non stop shaking. within seconds of getting there i had an episode and was basically laying in crap. i kept yelling out for help and not only did no one do anything no one even stopped to ask what was wrong. when my wife got there i got better care but only because she was tracking them down all the time.  there was one nurse or aid, not sure which, at the end that was very caring and nice. she was the standard that all staff should meet. oh and the cat scan tech was very good. but on the other hand i actually had one aid that kept trying to get me to walk to the bathroom. really, i had severe diarrhea and when it hit it hit and i was exhausted from dozens of times of crapping and vomiting and you want me to walk to the bathroom so you don't have to clean up. i get it but after you see what the patient is going through stop asking. i finally had to tell her if you make me try to walk to the bathroom you will wind up with crap on the floor instead of the bed because i can't control it. she finally stopped asking. i get it... all the jobs are hard, but there is such a difference in care when compared to other hospitals so the low level of care is not just because the job is hard. if you look at past reviews there is a history of poor care here and everyone knows it. everyone i talked to said why did you go there. well, if you have a choice don't go here.

this is for aspire hospital in conroe. call me crazy, but i believe medical institutions should be transparent about the amount patients are responsible for paying out of pocket. i also believe medical staff should be polite and helpful to each and every patient. i went here for imaging. i made sure to check what my out of pocket would be before arriving. once i arrived i was told i would be billed separately by the radiologist in addition to what they would be charging me. instead of helping me find out what additional costs i would incur, the lady at the front desk made me feel like i was being difficult when i stated i would like to call my insurance to ensure the radiologist was in network. she was rude and unprofessional. when my insurance wasn't able to tell me an exact amount but that the radiologist was in network i decided to go ahead with the imaging. the unprofessional front desk clerk decided to ask if i found out how much i would pay. when i told her they couldn't give me an exact amount she smiled and condescendingly said "i'm sorry". her response was immature and rude. she was unwilling to lift a finger to help me find out what my out of pocket would be to the radiologist. she kept saying it would be an insignificant amount of money. what does that me? what's insignificant to you? how is that helpful in any way? it's a shame she couldn't just be understanding and polite because the radiology technician was wonderful. the two stars are for her! but never going back to this place. i'll give my money to a healthcare organization that staffs their front office with friendly and helpful people!

how does one begin to rate a mental hospital? this place literally saved my life. every single person from staff to doctors and everyone in between was wonderful. these people are doing mental health care right. if they don't care then they're doing a hell of a job pretending.

*regarding their same-day surgical center*

i haven't had to go to the american fork hospital to have surgery or to have any of my babies; mainly because i've heard bad things about it. so when i heard i would be having a laryngoscopy and bronchoscopy here i was worried about the experience i might get in their same-day surgery center. i must say; my experience went great!

my procedure was originally scheduled at 4:30pm and i wasn't too happy about not eating all day during the holidays when there are so many goodies around my house; talk about will power. but around 10:30am that day i received a call from the surgical center and they said that they were ahead of schedule and wanted me there at 1:30pm instead! christmas miracle!

the surgical services are located on the second floor above the er. i hadn't actually been to that hospital in years (visiting friends or family there) and didn't know that they had this new "wing" to the hospital that was so nice and new! see pictures attached. 

the nurse helping me get prepped before surgery was so helpful and nice. her name was dian, and she made me feel like a person, not just another number on her list of people to get through the day and i really appreciated that. she said that there would be a few other people coming in, asking the same exact questions to reduce possible error and i asked her about how long that process takes. she said about 45 minutes until going back into surgery and that was nice to know so i wasn't just waiting thinking it would be 5-10 minutes and then be frustrated that it took longer. knowing the "schedule" made it easier to relax and watch some tv to distract myself. she also asked my husband if he needed a drink or anything because they have the hard part of waiting and worrying while i get a nap. so she got him something to drink and was very polite to him too. 

the anesthesiologist came in and explained what he would be doing and after he was done, i had some questions for him about his job because my 16 year old daughter wants to become an anesthesiologist too. he was awesome with answering any of the questions i had! he was way nice!

my doctor came in and explained what he would be doing as well. the procedure was then done and after waking up i was helped by a nurse named hannah (i'm pretty sure that was her name...i was coming off anesthesia so maybe that's completely wrong haha) but she was nice too. i was finally able to have some food like pudding and apple juice so that was nice after fasting all day. 

overall: i was very impressed and surprised by the great service i received here and would be able to say that i would recommend their same-day surgical services.
